description: Get historical weekly COVID-19 testing volume and positivity rate by country from ECDC TESSy surveillance data. Filter by country name or ISO2 code, optionally by ISO week. Covers 2020-W01 through 2023-W47 only — ECDC discontinued routine COVID-19 reporting in December 2023, so this reflects the final frozen historical dataset, not live surveillance. Data: ECDC opendata, CC BY 4.0, no auth required.

country.description: Country name or ISO2 country code to filter by (e.g. "Austria" or "AT"). Required — the upstream dataset has no server-side query, so this narrows the full historical dump.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 100, max 500).

year_week.description: Filter to a single ISO week, format "YYYY-Www" (e.g. "2021-W48"). Omit to return all weeks.

name: ecdc-surveillance.covid.testing_rate

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get ECDC COVID-19 Testing Rate
